newsitem.title: USA: Powerex, SDG&E to supply Baja, Mexico with power.
newsitem.headline: Powerex, SDG&E to supply Baja, Mexico with power.

text.p: Powerex, the power marketing unit of Canada's B.C. Hydro, and Enova Corp's San Diego Gas & Electric Co were the winners of a tender to supply electricity to Mexico's Baja California this summer, a spokeswoman for B.C. Hydro said Monday.
Powerex will supply 50 megawatts (MW) to Mexico's state power company, Comision Federal de Electricidad, during July through September, while SDG&E will supply 150 MW, she said.
"This is the first time a Canadian company has sold power into Mexico," the spokeswoman noted.
Officials at SDG&E couldn ot be immediately reached for comment.
The deal is worth just under C$2 million to Powerex, which has already lined up transmission access into Mexico, she added.
